name: The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort
positioning: Beachfront St. Regis resort in Muscat's Al Mouj, on a 360-meter beachfront a few steps from the Greg Norman-designed Al Mouj Golf Course, with yacht-inspired rooms
best_for: Golfers who want the Al Mouj Golf Course a few steps away
Families wanting duplex suites with kitchens, plus the Adventure Hub kids club

facts.text: The resort stretches along a 360-meter beachfront in Muscat, Oman.
The resort is in Al Mouj, near the marina, the airport, the opera house and the islands.
Muscat International Airport is approximately 8.1 kilometers from the hotel.
The Al Mouj Golf Course is a par-72 championship course stretching along a six-kilometer coastline.
Rooms and suites are inspired by luxury yachts and nautical themes.
Dining venues at the resort include COYA, Em Sherif and Hakkasan.
Afternoon Tea at The Lounge draws inspiration from the parties once hosted by Caroline Astor.
The Guerlain Spa has wet facilities with steam rooms and saunas.
The Guerlain Spa offers a wellness menu inspired by Omani philosophy and spirits.
Watersports at the resort include paddleboarding, kayaking and snorkeling; sunset cruises are available on request.
The Adventure Hub kids club has a games and TV area, an art and craft corner, a reading corner and a kids pool.
St. Regis butlers are available around the clock.

highlights.text: The Al Mouj Golf Course, designed by Greg Norman, is a few steps from the resort.
The Royal Suite has a private infinity pool and two jacuzzis.
Karibu serves breakfast and dinner, blending Omani specialties with influences from Zanzibar to India, inspired by the spice route.
At Zorba, Chef Thanos recreates his grandmother's recipes from the Greek Islands.
The duplex suites include a private deck with a plunge pool and direct access to the resort pool.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
WhataHotel notes the resort is outside central Muscat, so exploring the city requires transportation.
Pets are not allowed at the resort.
